Subject: Vendor setup: initial info needed for First Mile Logistics

Hi Alyssa / Samir,

Thanks for agreeing to work with Redwood. I'm Marissa from Procurement Ops — I own the vendor setup flow. To get you into our system and ensure timely payment, we need a few items from your side. Please reply to this thread with the documents or upload to the DocuSign link below.

Required items (minimum):
- Legal entity name as registered with IRS / national registry
- Legal address (headquarters) and remit-to address (if different)
- Tax ID / EIN or foreign tax identifier (attach W-9 or W-8BEN as applicable)
- Banking details for ACH or wire: routing number, account number, account holder name, bank name, and SWIFT/BIC if international
- AP contact name + email for invoice submission and vendor portal access
- Copy of a bank letter or voided check for verification (preferred for ACH)

Notes on Redwood PO & invoicing:
- Redwood prefers a PO for all purchases > $1,000. PO number should be included on invoice line items.
- Standard terms: Net 30 from invoice receipt unless otherwise agreed in SOW
- Invoices should be sent to invoices@redwood.ai and cc the AP contact you provide

I've attached our vendor onboarding form and an ACH authorization template to make this easier. DocuSign vendor packet: https://docu.sign/example/abc123

If you need alternative submission methods (secure portal upload, SFTP), let us know.

Thanks — once we receive the docs we'll route to Finance for verification and confirm vendor code / PO process.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, ach_authorization_template.pdf

Hi Alyssa — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and for the W-9. A few clarifications on our PO and payment practice to set expectations:

1) PO requirement: For standard services under $5k we can process invoices without a prior PO; however for recurring shipments and any professional services we typically require a PO before payment. If you flag invoices as urgent, Finance can triage them, but having a PO speeds automated matching.

2) Invoice fields we require for automated processing:
- Redwood PO number (if available)
- Invoice date
- Invoice number (unique)
- Line-item description and unit price
- Remit-to address (must match vendor record)

3) ACH vs wire: ACH is preferred for US payments. If you provide bank letter or a voided check, that will allow Finance to enable ACH payments. For international wires we'll need SWIFT plus intermediary bank info.

4) Security/compliance: We redact bank account numbers in tickets and only store an encrypted copy in our AP system. If you prefer us to receive bank details via SFTP, our IT can provision an account — let me know.

Next steps:
- Please upload the signed ACH template and bank letter to the DocuSign folder (https://docu.sign/example/abc123) or reply with the documents via SFTP request.
- Once Finance verifies, they'll create a vendor code and confirm whether a PO has been issued for the initial shipment. I'll update this thread when that is complete.

Thanks — looping Markus for any additional tax/contract questions.

Rachel Kim
Vendor Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
